description: 10 manually verified benchmark queries covering keyword, semantic, cross-document comparison, incident analysis, and safe abstention.

questions.text: What target chunk size and overlap are specified for Northstar document ingestion?
questions.reference_answer: Northstar specifies a target chunk size of 500 characters and a chunk overlap of 100 characters with sentence and newline boundary preservation.

questions.text: Which dense embedding model and vector index topology does Northstar employ for conceptual semantic search?
questions.reference_answer: Northstar uses 384-dimensional dense sentence embeddings from all-MiniLM-L6-v2 with an IndexFlatIP exact inner product FAISS index.

questions.text: What smoothing constant and formula does Northstar use to merge sparse and dense rankings?
questions.evidence_anchor: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with a standard smoothing constant of k=60
questions.reference_answer: Northstar merges sparse and dense rankings using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with a standard smoothing constant of k=60.

questions.text: What happens if a generated answer cites a chunk outside the retrieved evidence set?
questions.evidence_anchor: Any citation tag referencing a chunk outside the retrieved evidence set is flagged as an invalid citation.
questions.reference_answer: Any citation tag referencing a chunk outside the retrieved evidence set is flagged as an invalid citation by the citation resolver.

questions.text: What Recall@5 and NDCG@5 did Hybrid RRF achieve in the Q3 benchmark report?
questions.evidence_anchor: Hybrid RRF achieved superior Recall@5 (0.9625) and NDCG@5 (0.9420)
questions.reference_answer: In the Q3 benchmark evaluation, Hybrid RRF achieved a Recall@5 of 0.9625 and an NDCG@5 of 0.9420, outperforming both isolated sparse and dense baselines.

questions.text: How does the P50 latency of Okapi BM25 compare to neural dense vector inference in Northstar benchmarks?
questions.evidence_anchor: BM25 is ~270x faster than neural vector inference
questions.reference_answer: Okapi BM25 demonstrated a P50 latency of 0.12 ms, which is approximately 270 times faster than neural vector inference (32.50 ms).

questions.text: What specific query types were excluded from the Q3 benchmark evaluation dataset?
questions.evidence_anchor: Alphanumeric SKU lookups and single-token error code searches were excluded
questions.reference_answer: Alphanumeric SKU lookups and single-token error code searches were excluded from the 40-query evaluation set, representing a known coverage limitation.

questions.text: What caused the retrieval failure on product SKUs like NS-9000-XL in Incident INC-4091?
questions.evidence_anchor: pushing the correct chunk down to rank 7 or 8 (outside top-K=5)
questions.reference_answer: Dense retrieval populated top ranks with irrelevant clustered documents due to subword tokenization, causing RRF rank dilution to push the rank 1 BM25 hit down to rank 7 or 8.

questions.text: What corrective remediation actions were approved in Incident INC-4091 to prevent RRF dilution?
questions.evidence_anchor: When a query contains an exact alphanumeric token matching indexed hardware codes, the BM25 top hit is automatically pinned into the top-3 candidate evidence set.
questions.reference_answer: Remediation included lexical exact-match promotion (pinning BM25 top hit into top-3 for exact hardware codes), dense confidence thresholding (0.45), and safe abstention enforcement.

questions.text: What reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) reward model and PPO hyperparameters are used in Northstar?
questions.reference_answer: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: The Northstar documentation does not mention reinforcement learning from human feedback, reward models, or PPO hyperparameters. The system should abstain.
